text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has once again rolled around, and this year, we'll focus on training for the upcoming Arima Kinen and autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I give Biwa Hayahide her training schedule, she nods approvingly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This is incredible. You managed to find all this information on the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You even included data on the Arima Kinen and Brian's predicted times for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How much time did you spend on this? It must have been so much work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then for the purpose of solidifying my winning equation, I graciously accept your support.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll work hard for both our sakes.
